name: 86 Chaos 16.0.74 Schedule Runtime Recovery and Delete Marker Order Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.74 Schedule Runtime Recovery and Delete Marker Order Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.74 Schedule Runtime Recovery and Delete Marker Order Fix
notes: Published employee schedules now list the selected calendar month instead of pulling boundary days from another month.
Partial schedule publish now refreshes selected-day candidates from Firestore before publishing so visible draft shifts are not missed.
Deleted duplicate schedule shifts now keep fingerprint tombstones long enough to stop stale local or cached records from coming back, without hiding newly re-added shifts.
